entries.0adf6a51b8c1a60f: A monthly subscription fashion rental service for men started on May 28, 2026. The securities report states that it adds a men's service to the existing women's service to expand the target market. In March 2026 the company also started "Self Select" in "airCloset", in which customers choose items themselves.
entries.167bc7f9109ab14a: An initiative to let other companies' rental services also use what was built in operating "airCloset": item-level management using RFID, an in-house developed warehouse management system, dedicated cleaning and maintenance, and more. The securities report states that the company has been commissioned for 3 rental services.
entries.1b4b5222f1410c7b: Women living in Japan (the securities report states that they range widely from their 20s to their 50s, with a particular concentration in the late 30s to 40s)

entries.27be288357a73d68: Established in July 2014, the company listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in July 2022. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, so the figures in the annual securities report are those of the reporting company alone. Stylists under employment contracts with the company and stylists under outsourcing contracts together number more than 300.
entries.2afbb6256c230ab7: Through non-face-to-face online exchanges, customers and stylists share preferences while choosing clothing together. On the Regular Plan, three garments are sent at a time, and the next garments are sent once they are returned. Cleaning and maintenance are carried out by outsourced partner companies within the scope of the usage fee. Customers can purchase clothing they like.
entries.2f84ec8cc137fec0: Fashion rental service "airCloset" (monthly subscription personal styling)
entries.307e2d8b7b276835: A monthly subscription service started in February 2015 that lets customers rent clothing selected by stylists, entirely online without face-to-face contact.
entries.33800aeb50dad173: For the fiscal year ended June 2026, the company recorded an operating loss of ¥234,470 thousand (operating profit of ¥102,423 thousand in the previous year), an ordinary loss of ¥252,320 thousand (ordinary profit of ¥88,599 thousand in the previous year), and a net loss for the period of ¥246,717 thousand (net income for the period of ¥23,541 thousand in the previous year). The annual securities report cites factors including a shortfall against expected new member acquisition, which reduced the number of members, and higher advertising expenses accompanying the expansion of business scale. It also states that, through a review of member acquisition methods, the company aims to return to an operating profit in the next fiscal year.
entries.373788e6905d9a56: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,175,679 thousand, up 4.4% year on year. The annual securities report states that this was mainly due to an increase in the number of monthly members. However, the number of members at the end of the fiscal year decreased compared with the same point in the previous year. Cost of sales was ¥2,840,494 thousand (up 10.1% year on year), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥2,569,655 thousand (up 12.9% year on year).
entries.45f7cbbebf43f968: Monthly membership fee income (Regular Plan ¥10,980 per month, Light Plan ¥7,980 per month, Light Plus ¥13,980 per month)
entries.4643ca0fecdb3819: According to the [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]], the company mainly offers “airCloset,” a monthly subscription service that rents clothing selected by stylists to suit each customer’s preferences and delivers it to the homes of women living in Japan. It is a business structure that procures clothing, adds value through personal styling, and earns revenue from rental usage fees and sales revenue from purchases (buyout fees). Customers can have the next item sent after returning the one they have worn, and can also purchase clothing they like. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its only business segment is the Personal Styling Business. For the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue was ¥5,175,679 thousand (up 4.4% year on year), but the company recorded an operating loss of ¥234,470 thousand.
entries.4f4c9395a7a92bc6: A company that operates a monthly subscription service in which stylists choose clothing to suit each person's tastes and deliver it to their home for rental.
entries.4fbc6f0a5e640fd6: An initiative to let other companies' rental services also use what was built in operating "airCloset": item-level management using RFID, an in-house developed warehouse management system, dedicated cleaning and maintenance, and more.
entries.51e1e9b8f919184c: A pay-per-use service that uses the circular logistics platform to rent dresses worn at weddings and events.
entries.5605c0d35cbead21: External provision of the circular logistics platform “AC-PORT”
entries.6b825456432849bb: A monthly subscription service started in February 2015 that lets customers rent clothing selected by stylists, entirely online without face-to-face contact. The Regular Plan costs ¥10,980 per month; 3 items are chosen and sent at a time, and the next clothing is sent once the return is confirmed. There are also the Light Plan at ¥7,980 per month and the Light Plus Plan at ¥13,980 per month. Customers can purchase clothing they like. The securities report states that at the end of June 2026 there were 35 thousand monthly members and 1.6 million free members, and that the number of members at the end of the fiscal year was lower than at the same point in the previous year.
entries.6bfd13f9b63fe9b9: A pay-per-use service that uses the circular logistics platform to rent dresses worn at weddings and events. The securities report states that "airCloset Dress" started in November 2024, and that from October 2025 the scope was expanded to include black formal wear and outerwear, with efforts to raise awareness as "airCloset Spot Rental".
entries.8c3125deb9c87077: Provision of the circular logistics platform "AC-PORT" to external companies
entries.8d66fc1c5a09f391: The company's only business segment. Centered on "airCloset", a monthly subscription service that rents clothing selected by stylists to match each person's tastes to women living in Japan, it also operates "airCloset Mall", a rental mall where customers can try and buy home appliances, bedding and similar items, pay-per-use rental of dresses for weddings and events, and external sales of its logistics platform. The securities report omits segment-level disclosure because the company is a single segment with the Personal Styling Business as its only business segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,175,679 thousand (up 4.4% from the previous fiscal year) and operating loss was ¥234,470 thousand (compared with operating profit of ¥102,423 thousand in the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that monthly membership fees and sales from "airCloset" account for about 87% of revenue.
entries.9014994261e59426: Pay-per-use rental of dresses and other items, “airCloset Spot Rental”
entries.952ff7d379074ce3: A service started in April 2020 that provides manufacturers handling lifestyle products such as home appliances with a platform for subscription-type rental sales. Customers can try products at home before considering a purchase. Revenue consists of platform usage fees received from manufacturers, and a portion of rental revenue received from customers and of sales revenue linked to purchases (revenue share). Depending on the product, the company may purchase directly.
entries.af68ade1894ce665: Women in their 20s to 50s living in Japan (centred on women in their late 30s and 40s; the annual securities report states that working women account for 92.8% (as of June 2024) and women with children for 55.8% (as of April 2022))
entries.b0a229baaf093bfa: The annual securities report states that as of the end of June 2026 there were 35,000 monthly members and 1.6 million free members. The annual securities report states that the cancellation rate of monthly members slows after about three months from initial registration, and that loyal members, whose usage period exceeds six months, account for more than 65% of total members (as of the end of June 2025).
